music.vibe: indie-pop anthem with cinematic strings and a confident-warm female lead vocal, big stadium drum at the chorus
music.structure_note: Piano verse, drums build at the pre-chorus, full cinematic band at the chorus with the hook on the one, stripped acoustic outro.

tableaux.prompt: Hero subject: a folded cardinal-red running jersey on a wooden bedroom chair at dawn. Soft side-light through a window, dust motes drifting. Composition: low angle on the chair, intimate and anticipatory. The jersey is the hero.
tableaux.motion_hint: Dust motes drift through the light beam. The jersey stays still as hero. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Set the alarm before the sun
tableaux.prompt: A runner in her thirties laces a shoe on a porch step in the early morning, breath faintly visible, calm and resolved. Warm low sun rakes across the boards.
tableaux.motion_hint: Her hands finish the lace, she exhales. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Tie the laces, here we go
tableaux.prompt: Slow tracking shot of a runner moving down a quiet tree-lined street, golden light catching her hair, the cardinal jersey visible.
tableaux.motion_hint: Slow forward tracking dolly. Hair moves naturally. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Out the door while the street is still
tableaux.prompt: Wide cinematic shot — four runners crest a hill toward camera in the golden hour, a soft lens flare drifting diagonally across the frame.
tableaux.motion_hint: Slow forward run by all four. Lens flare drifts. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Feel it building in my chest
tableaux.prompt: Tight close-up of running feet striking wet pavement, droplets kicking up, motion blur at the edges.
tableaux.motion_hint: Feet strike in rhythm, handheld micro-wobble. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: Close-up of a runner's face mid-effort, jaw set, a single bead of sweat, eyes forward. Honey-gold rim light.
tableaux.motion_hint: A single hard breath, eyes lift. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Now the light is breaking through
tableaux.prompt: Slow-motion abstract beat — a spray of water droplets suspended mid-air in honey-gold light, a blurred runner behind. Frozen-time quality.
tableaux.motion_hint: Droplets drift downward in slow motion. Frozen-time. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: This is my comeback, every morning
tableaux.prompt: 4-quadrant split: four runners at four different times of one morning — porch, street, hill, track — each a cinematic mini-shot in cardinal and cream. THIS IS THE HERO FRAME.
tableaux.motion_hint: Each quadrant pulses in alternation to the beat. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: A runner crosses a crest into full sunrise, arms loosening, slow-motion, the brightest energy moment.
tableaux.motion_hint: Slow motion. Arms open. Sun blazes behind. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: PRODUCT HERO — the cardinal-red jersey hanging in single-source warm light against a dark wood wall, label catching the light.
tableaux.motion_hint: Slow-motion. The jersey sways imperceptibly. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: Contact-sheet 4-panel: shoelace pull, watch tap, gate latch, first stride — beat-locked to the lyric repetition.
tableaux.motion_hint: Each panel has its own subtle motion in alternation to the beat. 5 seconds.

tableaux.lyric_anchor: Long road home, I earned it slow
tableaux.prompt: A worn paper race bib pinned to a corkboard among older bibs — the runner's history, heavier film grain.
tableaux.motion_hint: A draft lifts the corner of the bib. Heavier grain. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: Twilight beat — a lone runner walking it out down a long road, low warm sky behind, reflective and earned.
tableaux.motion_hint: Slow tracking-out. She walks away. Light shifts gently. 5 seconds.

tableaux.prompt: A clean, warm, empty backdrop — a softly lit cream wall with a single shaft of dawn light. NO text, NO words, NO signage anywhere in frame (the wordmark is composited in post).
tableaux.motion_hint: Static hold. The light shifts imperceptibly. 5 seconds.
